notes: #1 (1741) and #12 (2008) show Cartagena, Colombia, and are excluded. #6 was published in 1872 but depicts the city as it was in the 18th century, so its date is not the date of the view; skipped. #4 (1792) and #2 (1824) are alternatives for P3. #8–#11 are airplane close-ups at Los Alcázares, not city views. #13 is a modest photo; the historic center is mostly off frame.
